patterns.title: Anomaly Detection in Access Logs
patterns.problem: High volume of access logs obscures attack vectors and system errors.
patterns.solution: 1. Ingest logs into centralized stream. 2. Filter by HTTP 4xx/5xx status codes. 3. Group by IP address and User-Agent. 4. Detect spikes in request rate (DoS). 5. Cross-reference with threat feeds.
patterns.author: Nanobot
